title: Registered voters per constituency for the 2022 General Election
note: Kuria East: 41,976 registered voters. Its five wards, from IEBC's register by polling station, add up to the same. Read 1 November 2026.

title: KURIA EAST Constituency: MP, Wards and Results
note: A third-party site carrying IEBC's declared results. 2017: all eight candidates as printed (surname first) and 26,771 valid votes, which they add up to. 2022 lists the winner only, so the 2022 race is entered from Mzalendo's copy of the Gazette instead. 2013 gives no parties, so it isn't entered. Its 36,301 registered voters is an earlier register than IEBC's 2022 one, so it isn't entered. Read 1 November 2026.

title: Migori County: elections, Parliament and public money
note: Reproduces IEBC's 2022 register by constituency and the Kenya Gazette's declared winners (Gazette 9950 for MPs), winners only. Kuria East: 41,976 registered; Kemero Maisori Marwa Kitayama, UDA, 15,362 votes, which agrees with BallotWinners. No source read gives the 2022 runner-up's votes, so the 2022 MP race holds the winner alone. Read 1 November 2026.

title: Ruto wins Kuria vote as Raila falters again
note: 13 August 2022. Kuria East's presidential result as printed: Ruto 16,795, Raila 12,031, Wajackoyah 144 and Mwaure 62, all four candidates. It gives no valid or rejected total, so none is entered.
